description: This file defines the LocationModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization, encapsulating a Location entity for API responses, and configuring filters and attribute mapping for a human resource management system.

classes.name: LocationModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps the Location entity to facilitate serialization and API response generation within the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LocationModel with a Location entity and configures attribute filters and names for serialization.
